aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the report but misstates the supplier comparison and omits key decision evidence.
issues: Changed factor is a filename, not the Zhongke vs normal Baotou supplier/material comparison.
Baseline and changed conditions are marked non-explicit despite source rows identifying them.
Outcome evidence misses normal short comparator and final decision rows.
Spec, sample count, and violation fields are unsupported and conflict with NG conclusions.
Cited row 7.6!27 is not included in provided context text.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to new Zhongke MG-S-A/MG-S-B material versus normal Baotou line/material.
Define baseline as normal SMG-S-A/S-B Baotou and changed condition as Zhongke sample test.
Group results by SMG long/MG-S-B and SMG short/MG-S-A, preserving spec and supplier context.
Add rows 43-48 and short normal comparator evidence; include row 7.6!27 text if used.
Correct judgement to not usable / supplier improvement needed with NG rates 1/40 and 4/40.
